description_en: Cancels the automatic snapshot policy that has been created for a file system
description_zh: 取消文件系统已创建的自动快照策略
name: CancelAutoSnapshotPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the target file systems.

You can specify up to 100 file systems in a single call. To cancel the automatic snapshot policy for multiple file systems, separate multiple file system IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
目标文件系统ID。

一次调用最多指定100个文件系统，当您需要取消多个文件系统的自动快照策略时，多个文件系统ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: file_system_ids

RequestId.description_en:
The request ID.

The request ID is returned regardless of whether the request is successful
RequestId.description_zh:
请求ID。

无论调用接口成功与否，都会返回请求ID
